investment_policy_en:
Strategy: The fund aims to achieve long-term capital growth from an actively managed portfolio consisting of pan-European equities. The Portfolio Manager’s investment philosophy is anchored on the belief that companies with quality characteristics such as stable earnings growth, attractive/ improving returns on capital, and high free cash flow are rewarded by the stock market over time.

Over the long term, shareholder returns follow company returns and a company’s return over the long term is driven by how efficiently a company converts accounting profits into cash profits, the strength and durability of the company’s competitive position which defines their ability to grow, and management’s ability to protect internal culture and allocate capital well.

The Manager’s analytical efforts are spent on understanding which businesses can maintain their earnings growth and which are improving more than the market discounts. His valuation framework is focused on mitigating drawdown risk. ESG is an integral part of the analysis of the quality of a business.

Objective: The fund aims to achieve capital growth over time.

Investment Policy: The fund invests at least 70% (and normally 75%) of its assets, in equities of companies listed on European stock exchanges. The fund may also invest in money market instruments on an ancillary basis.
